channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Primorsk port, oil tankers and military ships
item.description: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Primorsk port, targeting oil tankers and military ships. Ukraine continues to attack Russia's energy infrastructure against one of Russia's largest export gateways. Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Primorsk port, oil tankers and military ships.

item.title: The Insurgency Threatening to Derail a U.S.-Pakistan Pact
item.description: The Baloch Liberation Army's attacks may derail Pakistan's billion-dollar mining deal with the US. Attacks by the Baloch Liberation Army could derail Pakistan’s plans for a billion-dollar mining deal with the Trump administration.

item.title: Russia, Ukraine drones kill four; hit ‘shadow fleet’ tankers
item.description: Russia and Ukraine exchanged drone attacks, killing four and hitting tankers. Russia fired 268 drones and one ballistic missile in the overnight attack as Ukraine’s army launched at least 334 drones.

item.title: Trump reviewing Iran peace proposal as deadline for congressional authorization passes
item.description: US President Trump is reviewing an Iran peace proposal as the deadline for congressional authorization passes. The proposal aims to ease sanctions on Iran in exchange for limits on its nuclear program.

item.title: Between a fatwa and war: how Iran makes sense of its nuclear capability
item.description: Iran vows to protect its nuclear stockpile despite former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's disapproval of nuclear weapons. Iran has ‘vowed’ to protect its nuclear stockpile against Trump’s threats even as its former Ayatollah Ali Khamenei disapproved of using nuclear weapons on religious grounds.

item.title: Israel threatens Gaza war resumption to force disarmament as ‘truce’ frays
item.description: Israel threatens to resume war in Gaza to force disarmament as the truce frays. Palestinian factions reject US-backed plans linking aid to weapons surrender, demanding clear political path forward. Israel threatens Gaza war resumption to force disarmament as ‘truce’ frays.

item.title: Zelenskyy has no cards to play against Russia or the West
item.description: Ukraine's president struggles to secure gains for a peaceful resolution. The president seems unable to secure for Ukrainian people a gain that can compensate for a painful peace. Zelenskyy has no cards to play against Russia or the West.

item.title: Canada declares Khalistan extremists as ‘national security threat’
item.description: Canadian intelligence has designated Khalistan extremists as a national security threat, citing their involvement in the 1985 Air India bombing. The designation comes in a report released on the 40th anniversary of the attack.

item.title: Canada to be first non-European nation at EPC summit as Carney seeks allies
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney will attend the European Political Community summit in Yerevan, Armenia, marking the first time a non-European nation has participated in the meeting. Carney aims to build new ties with European nations.

item.title: Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts - The Tribune-Democrat
item.description: Iran proposes a 30-day end to war amidst Trump's doubts. Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts The Tribune-Democrat. Iran proposes end to war within 30 days as Trump expresses doubts - The Tribune-Democrat.

item.title: Iran says U.S. military operation ‘impossible’ as Trump mulls peace proposal
item.description: US President Donald Trump faces a choice between a military operation deemed impossible by Iran's intelligence organisation and a peace proposal, according to a state television post. The Islamic Republic of Iran has presented a proposal to Trump, who must decide on a course of action.

item.title: US to cut troops in Germany as Iran war spat deepens
item.description: The US plans to cut troops in Germany amid a deepening spat between President Trump and Chancellor Merz over the war on Iran. The move strains US-German relations, with tensions escalating between the two nations.

item.title: Trump says he is likely to reject peace proposal as Iran has 'not yet paid a big enough price'
item.description: US President Donald Trump has expressed doubts about an Iranian peace proposal, saying Iran has not yet paid a big enough price. Trump's comments suggest he may reject the proposal, which has been presented by the Iranian government.

item.title: Iran executes man convicted of killing security officer in 2022
item.description: Iran has executed a man convicted of killing a security officer in 2022. The execution was carried out despite international calls for a moratorium on capital punishment. Iran executes man convicted of killing security officer in 2022.

item.title: It does not make sense to invest more Arab resources in a US alliance
item.description: Arab leaders argue that investing in a US alliance is futile, as the US will always prioritize Israel's interests. They advocate for Arab unity as the key to establishing regional security.

item.title: Netanyahu boasts of Israel’s billion-dollar military investments
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has announced plans to invest $119 billion in developing the country's military capabilities. The investment aims to enhance Israel's defense systems. Benjamin Netanyahu says Israel will invest $119 billion USD into developing its own military weapons systems.

item.title: The Clandestine Network Smuggling Starlink Into Iran
item.description: Despite a 2025 Iranian law banning the use of Starlink devices, a clandestine network has been smuggling the technology into the country. In 2025, Iran passed a legislation that made using, buying or selling Starlink devices illegal.

item.title: Why Grid Stagnation Is A National Security Risk
item.description: China's entertainment industry is using A. I. to generate microdramas. Celebrities are threatening legal action over likeness use. The Geopolitical Tax: Why Grid Stagnation Is A National Security Risk Forbes.

item.title: How A.I. Is Transforming China’s Entertainment Industry
item.description: A. I. is transforming China's entertainment industry with generated microdramas. Actors say jobs have dried up. A. I.-generated microdramas have taken off. How A. I. Is Transforming China’s Entertainment Industry.

item.title: How Serbia's government dominates the country's media
item.description: Serbia's government has tightened its grip on the media since 2012, sparking fears of further restrictions ahead of an election. Since Serbia's ruling SNS party came to power in 2012, it has tightened its grip on the media.
